result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now exists as a name for the same command as `updateLandscape`. The `cli` module compiles and its tests pass. I didn't run the command itself, so the `config.json` and `index.html` output and the `-help` text are untested.

- **`Commands.java`**: I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description, which says it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. I also added `analyzeLandscape` to the no-argument usage overview, next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `analyzeLandscape` goes to the same method as `updateLandscape`, so the options and behaviour are identical. With `-help`, each name prints its own usage and description.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Landscape command" section. It shows `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>` and says `updateLandscape` still works.
